assumptions: Hotel operator controls the promised accommodation and has enforceable contracts; no accommodation lease or tax computation is included.

Reservation A is four equal $300 nights with three delivered by cutoff; its final night remains owed. Reservation B is cancelled, with documented entitlement to retain $200 and refund $400, no further service, refund or credit obligation.

journals.memo: Cancelled booking closes with supported refund and fee

assumptions: Restaurant controls food and selected mandatory service and has the contractual right to the service charge; tax and wage labels alone do not establish that revenue conclusion.
The POS tax amount is a supplied collection for government under the selected tax facts, not a jurisdictional rate. Voluntary tips belong to workers.

A supported payroll register supplies service-charge wages of $100 and combined withholding $34 and employer taxes $16.83. These are given inputs, not a calculation of legal wages, tip credits or tax liabilities. No other base wages are included in this incremental worksheet.

journals.memo: POS records separate sales, service, tax and tips
Tips and service wages paid with payroll withholding

assumptions: Restaurant controls $2,000 of food delivered to customers. The platform collects and retains a separately supported $400 service fee. Delivery, taxes and tips are excluded from this order population.
A supported $100 food refund reduces this same order population. Platform own books are not implied by the restaurant entries.
Separate inventory worksheet uses FIFO and owned food stock. Consumption, verified waste and remaining-stock NRV are distinct quantities.
NRV is a supplied supportable estimate for the remaining stock; the case does not calculate forecast selling prices. No recovery of already-disposed food is assumed.

Eligible nonpublic franchisor has adopted Topic 606 and elects the ASU 2021-02 expedient for specified pre-opening training. Training is delivered, the symbolic license is assumed to provide access evenly for 24 months, and month one is completed.
